title: FareedKhan-dev/train-llm-from-scratch: a plain-PyTorch path from tokens to alignment
friendlyTitle: Train LLM from Scratch teaches the full model-building pipeline
summary: This MIT-licensed educational repository implements a transformer and post-training pipeline in plain PyTorch, covering tokenisation, pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, reward modelling, PPO, DPO, GRPO, evaluation and chat. It has about 10,250 GitHub stars and gained roughly 196 stars in the day’s trending snapshot.
friendlySummary: The project shows how to build and train a transformer in plain PyTorch, then add several alignment methods. It has about 10,250 GitHub stars.
whyItMatters: Learners can trace how a language model moves from raw text to an aligned assistant without hiding the core algorithms behind high-level training libraries. The code is best treated as an educational reference; training meaningful models still requires careful data licensing, evaluation and substantial compute.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It is useful for understanding what training libraries normally hide. Start with small examples, because large models still need expensive hardware and carefully licensed data.
